verdict.rationale: Dynamics 365 Sales documents its own autonomous agent: the Sales Qualification Agent researches leads, drafts emails and flags priority leads on its own. It also claims you can 'automate business processes' and extend agents with external data sources. However, the evidence never shows how a user sets up, triggers or schedules their own background automations, so the user-configurable side of the story is thin. Missing for 10: documentation of user-defined automation setup (triggers, schedules, recurring background runs), detail on configuring agent behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Sales Qualification Agent autonomously researches leads using internal and external data, proactively drafts personalized customer emails, and flags high-priority leads for the next best action.
Build custom sales apps, automate business processes, and enrich seller experiences
Extend agents with external data sources to enhance the research signal strength.
